activity_title: Build automated daily PostgreSQL refresh with fail-safe validation
activity_summary: Built dashboard_refresh.py: an 8-step daily (10:00 cron) pipeline that connects to PostgreSQL, re-exports all 8 dashboard datasets, recomputes every KPI from raw rows (no hardcoded totals), validates the live export against the current data.js, writes a timestamped validation report, backs up the existing data.js before writing, appends logs/refresh.log, and replaces data.js ONLY when validation passes. On any connection or validation failure the previous dashboard is kept intact.
reusable_pattern: Snapshot-refresh pipeline: connect -> export raw -> recompute KPIs -> validate vs current -> report -> backup -> replace only on PASS -> log; never overwrite the live artifact on failure.
validation_rule: data.js must never be overwritten unless all validation checks pass (non-empty critical datasets, no duplicate/fan-out rows, positive KPIs, and each dataset within 0.5x-3.0x of the current row count).
gap_or_risk: The refresh role and the analytics role differ in privileges; a single hardcoded role cannot serve both the supplier and public data needs.
next_action: Wire the dashboard-v1 page rebuild into the same 10:00 job so the master table refreshes with data.js.

activity_title: Discover refresh role is public-schema only; add degraded refresh mode
activity_summary: Verified via has_schema_privilege that the provided refresh role (temp_user @149.28.134.54:5435) can read only the public schema and has NO access to the supplier schema, where new-components, PO, container, supplier and quantity data live. Implemented a DEGRADED mode: seed the new-component lineage from the component SKUs already in data.js, refresh the 6 public datasets live, and carry components + purchaseOrders forward unchanged; the script auto-upgrades to FULL mode when run with a supplier-capable role.
reusable_pattern: Capability-detect the DB role at runtime (has_schema_privilege) and degrade gracefully — refresh what the role can read, carry the rest forward, and label the output with the mode used.
validation_rule: Degraded mode requires the current data.js to supply the new-component SKU set; abort (do not write) if it is missing or empty.
gap_or_risk: supplier.* data (new components, PO, container, supplier, quantity) is in an un-mirrored purchasing DB reachable only via the broad MCP role, not the refresh role.
next_action: Provision the daily job a supplier-read role so components and purchase orders refresh live too.

activity_title: Fix traffic scope over-tightening; keep dedup-only (verified 120.77M organic)
activity_summary: Root-caused and corrected the traffic query. The real defect was a JOIN fan-out (refids DISTINCT on ref_id+channel+market_place but joined on ref_id only), inflating organic impressions ~5% (127.1M vs true 120.8M); the fix is a single GROUP BY ref_id dedup. An earlier revision ALSO added a created_at >= 2026-01-01 gate to refids, which wrongly dropped 6,394 of 7,630 qualifying-combo listings (combos listed before the window still earn in-window impressions), collapsing organic to 6.96M. Removed that gate: the window belongs on the traffic date, not the listing date. Verified organic = 120.77M after the fix.
evidence_refs: sql/traffic.sql; SQL verification organic 6.96M/119.5M/120.77M across refids variants A/B/C
reusable_pattern: For metric-through-a-bridge joins, dedup the bridge to one row per join key to prevent fan-out; apply the reporting window on the event date (traffic date), never on the linked entity's creation date.
validation_rule: Traffic refids must be one row per ref_id and must NOT be gated on listing created_at.
gap_or_risk: Aligning traffic scope to the listings created_at filter silently dropped ~86% of impressions; a row-count change guard is needed to catch such collapses before publish.
next_action: Keep a regression check asserting organic impressions stay near 120.8M after each refresh.

activity_title: Refresh fail-safe verified: change-guard blocked a bad publish
activity_summary: During a live run the validation change-guard flagged traffic collapsing from 7,567 to 1,082 rows (0.14x, below the 0.50x floor) and the script correctly REFUSED to overwrite data.js, proving the fail-safe. After the traffic fix the same run passed all guards (traffic 7,567 -> 7,572, 1.00x) and revenue reconciled to the main dashboard exactly (GBP 161,617.86), so data.js was backed up and replaced.
reusable_pattern: A catastrophic-change guard (per-dataset min/max ratio vs the current published artifact) that blocks auto-publish and forces human review on large swings.
validation_rule: FAIL any dataset whose new row count falls below 0.5x or above 3.0x of the current published count.
gap_or_risk: Guards on row counts alone would miss value-level corruption (e.g. impression inflation with stable row counts); KPI reconciliation is also required.
next_action: Add a KPI-delta section to the validation report comparing new vs current headline metrics.

activity_title: Build one-page master tracking view (Supplier's Basket to Customer's Home)
activity_summary: Built dashboard-v1/supplier_basket_to_customer_home.html: a single self-contained file (HTML+CSS+JS+embedded data) that reuses the exact existing dashboard theme (style.css inlined) and presents the full product lifecycle in ONE master table. Row grain = one Combo SKU x one platform using an activity-union model (a row exists for each combo/platform with a live listing OR completed orders OR returns). The 4 calculated columns (Days Since Listing, CTR%, Return Rate%, Visibility Gap Flag) are computed live in JavaScript and never stored. Toolbar (search, date range, supplier, marketplace, listing-status, visibility-gap, clear, CSV export) plus 8 KPI cards all recompute on filter change.
reusable_pattern: One self-contained lifecycle table at combo x platform grain with an activity-union row set and calculated columns computed in JS, so no order is dropped and visibility gaps surface as flagged rows.
validation_rule: Listing Status = Listed only when a live (not deleted, not ended) listing record exists for the combo/platform; otherwise Not Listed with a red GAP flag and row highlight.
gap_or_risk: A listing-centric grain dropped ~40% of orders (2,885 vs 4,807); the activity-union grain preserves all sales and matches the source revenue exactly.
next_action: Expose a combo-qty-created source if the business begins tracking assembly counts.

activity_title: Re-source dashboard-v1 fresh from PostgreSQL via MCP; author 7 SQL queries
activity_summary: Because the shared data.js snapshot had been modified and was gappy, re-sourced every dataset FRESH from PostgreSQL via Claude MCP (which reaches the supplier schema) instead of deriving from data.js. Authored 7 canonical, self-contained queries in dashboard-v1-sql/ (components, combos, component_combo_map, listings, traffic, orders, returns) plus _common.sql. Fields previously missing now come straight from source: qty = supplier.order_items.pcs; container = orders.container_id -> supplier.containers.name; supplier = supplier.suppliers.name; combo name = listing_data.title. Large MCP results auto-save to files; an assembler joins them into rows and embeds them into the HTML.
files_touched: dashboard-v1-sql/01_components.sql; dashboard-v1-sql/02_combos.sql; dashboard-v1-sql/03_component_combo_map.sql; dashboard-v1-sql/04_listings.sql; dashboard-v1-sql/05_traffic.sql; dashboard-v1-sql/06_orders.sql; dashboard-v1-sql/07_returns.sql; dashboard-v1-sql/_common.sql
evidence_refs: dashboard-v1-sql/*.sql; MCP json_agg exports; revenue reconciliation GBP 161,617.86
reusable_pattern: When a shared snapshot is untrusted, re-fetch from the database of record via MCP using per-dataset self-contained queries, and resolve gap fields to their true source tables rather than the snapshot.
validation_rule: New components = order_items SKUs whose MIN(created_at) >= 2026-01-01; every qualifying combo must contain at least one new component.
gap_or_risk: The modified data.js had near-empty container/qty and mis-scoped listings; snapshots drift and must not be treated as source of truth.
next_action: Add a persistent regenerate pipeline (SQL via MCP -> assembler -> HTML) so the page rebuilds on demand.

activity_title: Quantify and fix data gaps in the modified snapshot (containers, qty, listings)
activity_summary: Identified that the modified data.js under-reported reality: container and quantity fields were near-empty, and listings had been narrowed to is_child=1 AND created_at>=2026-01-01, hiding ~4,400 older-but-still-live listings. Fresh MCP sourcing corrected this: 3,697 of 4,389 combos are actually listed (only ~692 true gaps) versus the snapshot's inflated 4,134 not-listed; live listing rows rose from 1,354 to 5,797; and 99% of table rows now carry a real container and quantity.
evidence_refs: MCP counts: listings 5,797; combos listed 3,697/4,389; container/qty coverage ~99%
reusable_pattern: Define 'listed' as any live listing (not deleted, not ended) for the combo/platform regardless of creation date; do not filter listing visibility by created_at, which manufactures false gaps.
validation_rule: A combo is Listed if it has at least one live listing record on the platform; window filters belong on lifecycle dates, not on listing existence.
gap_or_risk: Filtering listings by is_child and created_at over-narrowed visibility and manufactured ~3,000 false 'not listed' gaps.
next_action: Document the canonical 'listed' definition in BLOS so future exports do not re-narrow it.

activity_title: dashboard-v1 UX: fixed shell (KPI cards + header frozen, only table scrolls)
activity_summary: Made the page operationally usable without altering the table format: removed the sidebar/nav for a single-purpose view; added // @ts-nocheck to the embedded script to clear editor red-lines on generated JS; froze the table header (thead sticky inside its own scroll box); locked the app bar, filter toolbar, KPI cards and pagination in place via a viewport-height flex shell so ONLY the table body scrolls; and increased the header bar height.
reusable_pattern: Fixed-shell layout: lock the main column to 100vh and lay it out as a flex chain so header/filters/KPIs/pagination stay put and only the data region scrolls, with a sticky table header.
validation_rule: Only the table body may scroll; header, filters, KPI cards and pagination remain visible at all times.
gap_or_risk: Editor checkJs flags generated JS with implicit-any red-lines; suppress with @ts-nocheck on the generated script block.
next_action: Reuse the fixed-shell + frozen-header pattern for other wide operational tables.

activity_title: dashboard-v1 UX: clipped columns + tooltip, All pagination, row detail drawer
activity_summary: Added three usability features without changing the table format: (1) fixed-width (240px) single-line clipping with ellipsis on Combo Product Name and Component Description, revealing full text via a viewport-aware overlay on hover without layout shift; (2) reduced pagination footer padding and added an 'All' rows-per-page option that renders the full filtered set on one page; (3) a row-click detail drawer that shows all 30 columns grouped into 8 lifecycle sections (Supplier & Container, Component, Combo, Listing, Traffic, Sales, Returns, Traceability) with the same chip/date/money formatting and live-calculated fields, closeable by button, backdrop or Esc.
evidence_refs: dashboard-v1/supplier_basket_to_customer_home.html; jsdom drawer/tooltip tests; tsc checkJs clean
reusable_pattern: Reveal-without-reflow pattern: clip wide cells to a fixed width and surface full content via an absolutely-positioned overlay tooltip plus a grouped row-detail drawer, keeping the dense table layout stable.
validation_rule: Fixed-width text columns must never change the table layout; full content is shown via overlay/drawer, not by expanding the cell.
gap_or_risk: Rendering the full unpaginated set ('All') on very large result sets is heavy; encourage filtering first.
next_action: Add per-section copy/export inside the detail drawer if requested.
